hints.text: 'Regularly' and 'kept behind' are our indicators — one tells us to take alternating letters, and the other tells us to move one part behind, or to the other side of, some others.
Our fodder is 'Beings', 'Area' and '51' — we'll need to swap in some substitutes for a couple, and use the letters of the other (as an indicator directs).
The definition is the whole clue — this is an &lit! It’s describing some beings that might literally be kept behind Area 51 (if you believe the rumours)...
